about: Raster prototype (ADR 0008): rooms with shapes for the 3-wide tower. All rooms of content.json with shapes. Shapes are cells [x, y] with y pointing up; height = number of cells (tempo cost). Fusions: parts with their cells relative to the first part's first cell; the result is placed there (rotation 0) and must lie within the parts' cells.
